lines.text: Star light, star bright, first star I see tonight!
Today is the Winter Solstice—the shortest day and longest night of the whole year!
But did the sun take a nap? No, it's all about Earth's secret tilt!
Planet Earth spins tilted like a spinning top at twenty-three degrees!
In December, the top half of Earth leans furthest away from the sun's warm rays!
Because of that tilt, the sun takes a very low, quick shortcut across the winter sky!
Less daytime sunlight means long, cozy nights for stargazing and dreaming!
And starting tomorrow, the days start getting brighter and longer again!
Celebrate the solstice with us and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
